story.text: 제주신화테마파크 입구에서 표를 끊고 들어서자, 알록달록한 놀이기구들이 눈앞에 펼쳐졌다. 용우는 이런 데 처음 온 사람처럼 신기한 듯 주위를 둘러봤다.
story.reading: je-ju-sin-hwa-te-ma-pa-keu ip-gu-e-seo pyo-reul kkeun-ko deul-eo-seo-ja, al-lok-dal-lok-han nol-i-gi-gu-deul-i nun-ap-e pyeol-chyeo-jyeot-da. yong-u-neun i-reon de cheo-eum on sa-ram-cheo-reom sin-gi-han deut ju-wi-reul dul-leo-bwat-da.
story.en: The moment we bought tickets and walked into Jeju Shinhwa Theme Park, colorful rides spread out before our eyes. Yongwoo looked around with curious eyes, like someone visiting a place like this for the first time.

story.text: 제일 높은 롤러코스터 앞에 서자 내가 먼저 발을 뺐다. '나 저건 진짜 못 타.' 용우가 어이없다는 듯 픽 웃었다. '겁쟁이처럼 굴지 마라. 별거 아니다.'
story.reading: je-il nop-eun rol-leo-ko-seu-teo ap-e seo-ja nae-ga meon-jeo bal-eul ppaet-da. na jeo-geon jin-jja mot ta. yong-u-ga eo-i-eob-da-neun deut pik us-eot-da. geob-jaeng-i-cheo-reom gul-ji ma-ra. byeol-geo a-ni-da.
story.en: Standing in front of the tallest roller coaster, I was the first to back out. 'I really can't ride that.' Yongwoo let out a small, incredulous laugh. 'Don't act like a coward. It's nothing.'

story.text: 결국 함께 탄 롤러코스터가 멈추자, 얼굴이 하얗게 질린 건 오히려 용우 쪽이었다. 손잡이를 어찌나 꽉 쥐었는지 손가락 마디가 하얘져 있었다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk ham-kke tan rol-leo-ko-seu-teo-ga meom-chu-ja, eol-gul-i ha-ya-ke jil-lin geon o-hi-ryeo yong-u jjog-i-eot-da. son-jab-i-reul eo-jji-na kkwak jwi-eot-neun-ji son-ga-rak ma-di-ga ha-ya-jyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: When the roller coaster we finally rode together came to a stop, it was Yongwoo, of all people, whose face had gone pale. He'd gripped the handle so hard his knuckles had turned white.

story.text: '너 방금 완전 쫄았잖아.' 놀리는 나를 향해 용우가 헛기침을 하며 딴청을 피웠다. '쫄긴 누가. 그냥… 조종간이 없으니까 좀 낯설어서 그렇다.'
story.reading: neo bang-geum wan-jeon jjol-at-jan-a. nol-li-neun na-reul hyang-hae yong-u-ga heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo ttan-cheong-eul pi-wot-da. jjol-gin nu-ga. geu-nyang, jo-jong-gan-i eob-seu-ni-kka jom nat-seol-eo-seo geu-reo-ta.
story.en: 'You totally chickened out just now.' As I teased him, Yongwoo cleared his throat and pretended to be occupied with something else. 'Chickened out, who. It's just... it felt a bit strange without a control stick.'

story.text: 사격 게임장 앞에서는 정반대의 모습이었다. 목표물을 응시하는 눈빛이 순식간에 진지해지더니, 총알 다섯 발이 모조리 과녁 중앙에 꽂혔다.
story.reading: sa-gyeok ge-im-jang ap-e-seo-neun jeong-ban-dae-ui mo-seub-i-eot-da. mok-pyo-mul-eul eung-si-ha-neun nun-bit-i sun-sik-gan-e jin-ji-hae-ji-deo-ni, chong-al da-seot bal-i mo-jo-ri gwa-nyeok jung-ang-e kkoj-hyeot-da.
story.en: At the shooting game booth, it was the exact opposite scene. The look in his eyes turned serious in an instant as he stared down the target, and all five shots landed dead center.

story.text: '와, 이거 실력 뭐야.' 감탄하는 나에게 용우가 상품으로 받은 커다란 곰 인형을 무심하게 안겨 주었다. '그냥 심심해서 해본 거다. 필요 없으면 버려도 되고.'
story.reading: wa, i-geo sil-lyeok mwo-ya. gam-tan-ha-neun na-e-ge yong-u-ga sang-pum-eu-ro bad-eun keo-da-ran gom in-hyeong-eul mu-sim-ha-ge an-gyeo ju-eot-da. geu-nyang sim-sim-hae-seo hae-bon geo-da. pil-yo eob-seu-myeon beo-ryeo-do doe-go.
story.en: 'Wow, what's with those skills.' As I marveled, Yongwoo casually handed me the giant bear he'd won as a prize. 'Just did it because I was bored. Throw it away if you don't need it.'

story.text: 하루 종일 걸어 다닌 다리가 뻐근했지만, 곰 인형을 품에 안고 야경을 바라보는 마음은 가볍기만 했다. '재밌었제? 다음엔 더 높은 것도 타보자.' 용우가 능청스럽게 웃으며 말했다.
story.reading: ha-ru jong-il geol-eo da-nin da-ri-ga ppeo-geun-haet-ji-man, gom in-hyeong-eul pum-e an-go ya-gyeong-eul ba-ra-bo-neun ma-eum-eun ga-byeop-gi-man haet-da. jae-mi-iss-eot-je? da-eum-en deo nop-eun geot-do ta-bo-ja. yong-u-ga neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: My legs ached from a whole day of walking, but my heart felt light as I hugged the bear and looked out at the night view. 'Fun, wasn't it? Next time let's ride something even taller.' Yongwoo said it with an innocent, knowing smile.

words.example_en: He backed away like a coward.

words.meaning: to turn pale, to lose color (from fear or shock)
words.example_en: His face turned pale white at the scary scene.

words.meaning: to act distracted, pretend to be occupied with something else
words.example_en: He dodged the question by acting distracted.
The arrow landed right in the center of the target.

words.meaning: to act nonchalant or innocent despite knowing better
words.example_en: He smiled innocently and let it slide.

sentences.ko: 용우는 겁쟁이처럼 굴지 말라며 나를 놀렸다.
sentences.reading: yong-u-neun geob-jaeng-i-cheo-reom gul-ji mal-la-myeo na-reul nol-lyeot-da
sentences.en: Yongwoo teased me, telling me not to act like a coward.

sentences.ko: 롤러코스터를 타고 난 그의 얼굴이 하얗게 질려 있었다.
sentences.reading: rol-leo-ko-seu-teo-reul ta-go nan geu-ui eol-gul-i ha-ya-ke jil-lyeo iss-eot-da
sentences.en: After riding the roller coaster, his face had turned pale white.

sentences.ko: 그는 딴청을 피우며 무서웠던 걸 인정하지 않았다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun ttan-cheong-eul pi-u-myeo mu-seo-wot-deon geol in-jeong-ha-ji anh-at-da
sentences.en: He acted distracted, refusing to admit he'd been scared.

sentences.ko: 그가 쏜 총알이 모두 과녁 중앙에 꽂혔다.
sentences.reading: geu-ga sson chong-al-i mo-du gwa-nyeok jung-ang-e kkoj-hyeot-da
sentences.en: All the shots he fired hit the dead center of the target.

sentences.ko: 그는 능청스럽게 웃으며 다음 놀이기구를 권했다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge us-eu-myeo da-eum nol-i-gi-gu-reul gwon-haet-da
sentences.en: He smiled innocently and suggested the next ride.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 나 저 롤러코스터 진짜 못 탈 것 같아.
turns.reading: na jeo rol-leo-ko-seu-teo jin-jja mot tal geot gat-a.
turns.en: I really don't think I can ride that roller coaster.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 겁쟁이처럼 굴지 마라. 내가 옆에 있는데 뭐가 무섭노.
turns.reading: geob-jaeng-i-cheo-reom gul-ji ma-ra. nae-ga yeop-e it-neun-de mwo-ga mu-seom-no.
turns.en: Don't act like a coward. What's there to be scared of with me right beside you.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너도 처음 타는 거 아니야? 왜 이렇게 자신만만해.
turns.reading: neo-do cheo-eum ta-neun geo a-ni-ya? wae i-reo-ke ja-sin-man-man-hae.
turns.en: Isn't this your first time riding it too? Why are you so confident.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 기장인데 이 정도야 당연하지. 걱정 말고 타자.
turns.reading: gi-jang-in-de i jeong-do-ya dang-yeon-ha-ji. geok-jeong mal-go ta-ja.
turns.en: I'm a captain, this much should be nothing. Don't worry, let's just ride it.

dialogues.question: 용우가 자신만만하게 행동한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo acted so confident?
dialogues.correct_answer: 손님을 안심시키려는 마음에서 자신 있게 행동했다
options: 손님을 안심시키려는 마음에서 자신 있게 행동했다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 무서워하는 손님을 안심시키려고 일부러 자신 있게 행동했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너 방금 완전 쫄았잖아. 손 봐, 하얘졌어.
turns.reading: neo bang-geum wan-jeon jjol-at-jan-a. son bwa, ha-ya-jyeoss-eo.
turns.en: You totally chickened out just now. Look at your hands, they've gone white.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 쫄긴 누가. 그냥 조종간이 없으니까 좀 낯설어서 그렇다.
turns.reading: jjol-gin nu-ga. geu-nyang jo-jong-gan-i eob-seu-ni-kka jom nat-seol-eo-seo geu-reo-ta.
turns.en: Chickened out, who. It's just that it felt strange without a control stick.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: That's just an excuse. Admit what you should admit.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: …됐고, 저기 사격 게임이나 하러 가자. 내가 인형 하나 따줄 테니까.
turns.reading: dwaet-go, jeo-gi sa-gyeok ge-im-i-na ha-reo ga-ja. nae-ga in-hyeong ha-na tta-jul te-ni-kka.
turns.en: ...Forget it, let's go play that shooting game over there. I'll win you a stuffed animal.

dialogues.question: 용우가 조종간 핑계를 대는 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo makes the excuse about the control stick?
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 자신도 무서웠다는 사실을 인정하기 싫어 그럴듯한 핑계를 둘러댔습니다.
